svg.title: TWELVE — a small game about the year
svg.desc: An editorial game screen on warm paper: a twelve-month dial with a sweeping hand, a year ledger, and the rules of play. The needle turns through all twelve months in a loop, lighting each month as it passes.

g.text: The year is a dial. The hand
Press when the hand crosses the lit month. Keep
all twelve and the year is yours. Three wrong
Lock the lit month as the hand passes through it.
Three wrong taps cost you the year. No timer.
Hit the middle of a month to keep it clear.
A month counts when you keep it.

svg.text: TWELVE / A SMALL GAME ABOUT TIME
